name: Booth
summary: A young, founder-led smile studio, Instagram-first and clinical where it matters: a photo-booth strip of four laughing smiles as the hero (laid flat across the page on desktop, upright on a phone and never taller than the screen), developing one frame at a time; the dentist's own words in italic; "tell me what you'd change" writes the message to the studio; the wedding countdown on an espresso band. White ground, warm black-and-white photographs, one lavender accent. Reddit Sans light for the headline and facts, Brygada 1918 italic only for the clinician's voice. For whitening and aesthetic dental studios.
